decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core to a large established German work-shoe maker, and with only one year of results and ample slack, management has no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The comfort insole is a low-cost complement that supports the core safety-shoe business, so slack allows the firm to carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The supportive insole overlaps somewhat with the other insoles, but there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, so it is likely kept for now.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page, which signals strategic commitment and expected performance at or above aspiration, so dropping it is unlikely.
Firefighter boots serve a specialised niche with longer certification and procurement cycles, so management will tolerate slow early results using slack.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page shows strong management attention and likely success, so there is little reason for problemistic search to reallocate its resources.
